correctness.rationale: From the actual Cayley generators on Z4², independent shortest-path enumeration gives 16 vertices, degree6, distance distribution (1,6,9), and 12 linear generators fixing 0, yielding 192 affine graph automorphisms, matching the published full order. The four displacement orbits have sizes 1,6,3,6. For each representative, independently generated every length4 magnitude-chain basis and signed d3,d4, checked d3d4=0, and computed full integer SNF: for distance0 dims C2,C3,C4=(9,54,96), ranks d3,d4=(9,45), H3=0; distance1 (6,54,80), ranks(6,48), H3=0; both distance2 orbit reps (4,66,80), ranks(4,61), H3=Z. All nonzero SNF factors of d3/d4 equal 1, proving torsion-freeness, 144 localized Z copies in total. Independent rational cohomology cocycle action verifies signs on every representative stabilizer: H_(0,2): two + two -, H_(1,2): one + one -. Integral rank-one fiber action has same ± signs. Endpoints induce full 192-group lattice modules; invariant zero and each nontrivial stabilizer coinvariants Z/2, total (Z/2)².

Complete local Smith and sign classification is a natural exact invariant useful for equivariant magnitude homology comparisons.
